title: Designer label audit, one line per Red round (contract 6.8, D16)
description: One line of data/audits/<match_id>.jsonl (dev) or data/golden/audits/<match_id>.jsonl (committed golden reference). Written by the DESIGNER after the match, outside the immutable match folder; the single source of truth for label verdicts (the markdown sheet is a generated view). verdict valid: the attack is a genuine instance of its claimed CWE label. invalid: it is not; the round is EXCLUDED from the audited statistics, never relabeled. unaudited: the scaffold default, not yet decided. Judge output is never changed. Red and Blue never read this file.

allOf.comment: a decided verdict names its reason, who decided, and when
